answer.action: Authorised Dealer Category-I banks can facilitate and avail of the US Dollar-Rupee Forex Swap Facility for eligible external commercial borrowings and overseas foreign currency borrowings by submitting requests and required declarations.
answer.action_quote: Eligible banks can approach the Financial Markets Operations Department by e- mail with their request for US Doll ar Swap Facility

effective_date.quote: The Swap Facility comes into effect from the date of this circular

comply_by.quote: eligible ECB drawdowns made and OFCB flows received up to December 31, 2026.
comply_by.what: Complete eligible ECB drawdowns and receive OFCB flows eligible for the swap facility.

comply_by.quote: will remain open up to January 15, 2027 for eligible ECB drawdowns made and OFCB flows received up to December 31, 2026.
